realizes.rationale: This gate keeps native held messages waiting during an active provider limit, checks ended stamps once for confirmed archive or absence, and publishes known reset timestamps to HeldResetIndex (releasing the claim on write error) so the independent reset scheduler wakes at reset.

1.note: The drain bypasses uncreated deferred held receipts, uses one confirmation read per new ended stamp for limited live seats, and resolves held messages on confirmed archive or absence.
